assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: A straight road (thick grey line) with Alex's position A and the camp B both 10 above it and 45 apart; the dashed green segment AB is the all-desert route, and the blue route goes from A down to P on the road (12.5), along the road to Q (30) and up to B (12.5), with horizontal offsets 7.5 at each end.

difficulty_rationale: Without calculus one must reduce every route to two desert legs and a road segment and then find the perfect-square inequality 5 sqrt(100+u^2) - 3u >= 40; a meaningful insight.
